result_gate: PASS only when every recorded check passes

pdf_generation.mechanism: C:/up/tools/unicode_markdown_pdf.py build_pdf() via installed Chrome and PyMuPDF

option_formatting_cues.metric: Unicode character count of each visible option
option_formatting_cues.comparability_threshold: max-minus-min <= 200 and max/min <= 2.20; locked answer-cue rates remain 15-40% correct-longest and 5-30% uniquely-longest

thresholds.exclusive_correct_rule: fail when a feature occurs in at least two correct options and zero distractors
thresholds.exclusive_distractor_rule: fail when a feature occurs in at least two distractors and zero correct options
thresholds.low_frequency_rule: fail when more than 50% of 2-12 occurrences are in correct options
thresholds.common_feature_rule: for more than 12 occurrences, fail when correct-option rate exceeds 2x distractor-option rate by at least 5 percentage points
thresholds.common_distractor_rule: for more than 12 occurrences, fail when distractor-option rate exceeds 4x correct-option rate by at least 20 percentage points
thresholds.within_question_rule: fail when the correct option alone carries a listed marker
thresholds.all_distractors_rule: fail when all three distractors and not the correct option carry a listed marker

requirements: all 212 rationales reproduce the parsed audit manifest
correct rationales contain at least two declared doctrinal anchors
each distractor quotes the exact false proposition and exact correction
each distractor rationale contains at least two declared correction anchors
generic negative controls satisfy no option's anchor set
normalized and near-duplicate rationale bodies are rejected
specific_distractor_explanations.validation_basis: Pass/fail is proposition-specific and manifest-driven; rationale word counts and enumerated stock-sentence blacklists are not acceptance criteria.
generic_negative_controls: This option is incorrect because it conflicts with the doctrine, while the correct answer states the relevant distinction.
The proposed answer preserves the relevant philosophical position and the other alternatives are mistaken.
This is correct within the documented scope because it accurately describes the issue under review.

mcq_proposition_audit.mechanical_limitations: This parsed proposition-level audit verifies exact stem and option alignment, declared referents, one keyed true proposition, explicit false propositions, specific corrections, and literal item-specific rationale anchors. Truth values were manually reviewed against the cited Topic 09 sources; parsing cannot independently prove philosophical truth or eliminate every reasonable interpretive dispute.

source_lineage.mechanical_limitations: This gate verifies file identity, source anchors, term witnesses, matrix ranges and declared candidate links. It does not prove semantic completeness or the philosophical correctness of each adaptation.

limbs.limb: constitution as disclosure rather than production
significance for givenness, non-substantialism and essences

pyq_demand_audit.mechanical_limitations: This gate checks exact prompt identity and literal presence of all declared demand-limb anchors inside each timed answer. It does not infer whether those anchors are argued correctly, sufficiently developed or worthy of a particular mark.

text_and_diff_integrity.mechanism: Stage-independent UTF-8 and trailing-whitespace audit of every package .md/.py/.json file, plus git diff --check for tracked INDEX.md and STATUS.json.
